findings.current: I had been fighting constantly for as long as I could remember.
findings.defect: The draft changes an unspecified point in the past into Jin’s entire remembered life.
findings.rationale: 언젠가부터 means “from some point onward,” not “for as long as I could remember.”
findings.replacement: At some point, I had begun fighting without end.

findings.current: Without retreating even an inch, I slowly pulled back the fist pressed against the Sword God’s blade.
findings.defect: The draft misreads 검신 as the title “Sword God” and invents that the blade belongs to that person.
findings.rationale: Here 검신 denotes the body or blade of Michael’s sword, as confirmed by the ongoing fist-versus-sword clash.
findings.replacement: Without retreating even an inch, I slowly drew back the fist that had been locked against the sword blade.
findings.source: 나는 한 치의 물러섬도 없이 검신을 향해 맞닿아 있던 주먹을 천천히 거두어들였다.

findings.current: And at the moment powerful killing intent and the sound of blades cutting through the air shot toward me—
findings.defect: The draft specifies blades as the source of the air-splitting sounds, although the source does not identify what produced them.
findings.rationale: 파공성 describes sounds produced by something tearing through the air; “blades” is an unsupported addition.
findings.replacement: And at the moment powerful killing intent and sharp, air-splitting sounds hurtled toward me—
findings.source: 그리고 강렬한 살기(殺氣)와 파공성이 뒤섞여 나를 향해 쏘아지던 그 순간.

findings.current: A dry laugh seeped into the voice that followed, impossible to hide.
findings.defect: The draft turns an amused quality in Michael’s dry voice into an actual laugh.
findings.rationale: 웃음기 is a trace or note of amusement in the voice, not a separate vocalized laugh.
findings.replacement: An unmistakable note of amusement seeped into the dry voice that followed.
findings.source: 그리고 뒤이어 들려오는 건조한 목소리에는, 숨길 수 없는 웃음기가 스며들어 있었다.

findings.current: That horrifying sensation of being dragged into a deep swamp made me reflexively lash out with my sword.
findings.defect: The draft reverses the physical action by making Jin attack with a sword instead of knocking Michael’s sword blade away.
findings.rationale: 검신을 뿌리쳤다 means Jin shook or knocked away the sword blade with which his fist was locked; it does not say he wielded a sword.
findings.replacement: That horrifying sensation of being dragged into a deep swamp made me reflexively knock the sword blade away.
findings.source: 마치 깊은 늪으로 끌려 들어가는 그 소름 끼치는 감각에 나는 반사적으로 검신을 뿌리쳤다.

findings.current: Before I had time to think, I twisted my body and staggered away, breathing harshly.
findings.defect: The draft changes an involuntary stagger into a deliberate twisting movement and adds that Jin moved away.
findings.rationale: 신형을 비틀거린 describes Jin’s body staggering; it does not mean he intentionally twisted it, and the source gives no direction of movement.
findings.replacement: Before I even realized it, I was staggering and breathing harshly.
findings.source: 마지막으로 번쩍이는 섬광 속에서 낯익은 얼굴들이 눈앞을 스쳤고, 의식할 새도 없이 신형을 비틀거린 나는 거칠게 호흡했다.

findings.current: It had been custom-built with every kind of cutting-edge equipment and even Magic, at a cost of hundreds of billions.
findings.defect: The monetary quantity is left without its implied Korean currency, making the scale ambiguous and potentially suggesting hundreds of billions of dollars.
findings.rationale: 수천억 in this Korean setting denotes hundreds of billions of won; retaining the currency is necessary to preserve the actual quantity.
findings.replacement: It had been custom-built with every kind of cutting-edge equipment and even Magic, at a cost of hundreds of billions of won.
findings.source: 온갖 최첨단 설비에 마법까지, 수천억을 들여 주문 제작한 것이었지만 별다른 감정은 들지 않았다.

findings.current: He recalled the young man from head to toe—a young man who had not even lived half of his life—and the enormous power coiled within him.
findings.defect: The draft makes the comparison against the young man’s own lifespan, producing an illogical claim and losing the intended age comparison with Michael.
findings.rationale: 자신이 살아온 인생 refers to the life Michael himself has lived: Jin is not yet half Michael’s age.
findings.replacement: He pictured the young man, not even half his own age, from head to toe, and once more considered the enormous power coiled within him.
findings.source: 아직 자신이 살아온 인생의 절반도 지나지 않은 청년의 머리부터 발끝까지. 또 그 안에 웅크린 거대한 힘을 다시금 떠올리며 생각했다.

findings.current: Even after the entire story had ended, the spacious suite remained filled with heavy air and silence.
findings.defect: The draft suggests that a narrative or sequence of events ended rather than that Jin finished telling the others everything.
findings.rationale: In context, 모든 이야기가 끝난 이후 refers to the completion of Jin’s account to Team Leader Choi and the Skeleton King.
findings.replacement: Even after I had finished telling them everything, the spacious suite remained filled with heavy air and silence.
findings.source: 모든 이야기가 끝난 이후에도, 넓은 스위트룸 내부는 무거운 공기와 침묵으로 가득 차 있었다.

summary: The draft contains two critical physical-action reversals, along with altered timeframe, currency, age comparison, and several localized fidelity issues.
